display.purpose: The page title, once per screen, over a 6 px ink rule. Width axis 75.

numeral.purpose: The catalogue number of an object (01 to 11). Width axis 62. Never numbers sections.

lead.purpose: One plain-French sentence under the page title, max 62ch.

body.purpose: Values and prose. Tabular figures wherever data aligns.

label.purpose: Table heads, verdict tags, group titles. Uppercase, +0.04em.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing (ease-out-quart): state changes, page slides, plate entrances. Nothing bounces.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Bars filling, switch sliders, dialogs sliding up.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a screen: Mandarin fill, ink text, inverting on hover.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Irreversible actions only: permanent deletion, emptying the Recycle Bin.

components.name: Specimen Plate
components.description: A numbered plate: title on the left, condensed catalogue numeral on the right, ruled spec rows below.
components.css: .plate{padding:24px;border:2px solid #0D2B24;border-radius:2px;background:#E8E4CC;color:#0D2B24;font-family:'Archivo Variable',sans-serif}.plate header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between}.plate h2{margin:0;font:700 24px/1.1 'Archivo Variable',sans-serif}.plate .num{font:850 96px/.78 'Archivo Variable',sans-serif;font-stretch:62%}.plate dl{margin:16px 0 0}.plate dl div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:9.5rem 1fr;gap:12px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(13,43,36,.35)}.plate dt{font-size:13px;color:#3B5C52}.plate dd{margin:0;font-weight:600}

components.name: Ruled Bar
components.description: Usage as a ruler: ink-bordered track, 10 % graduations, Forest fill that turns Mandarin once usage is high.

components.name: Verdict Tag
components.description: Text first: SUPPRIMABLE, DÉSINSTALLER (forest) or PROTÉGÉ (dashed). Colour only supports the word.

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: Un-numbered navigation on the forest rail; the active item is a Crest tab that slides between items.

narrative.overview: treemap reads one PC the way an industrial catalogue of the Olivetti and Braun years reads a product range: every part, drive, game and process is a numbered specimen on a sheet, measured and explained in plain French. The surface is flat: colour arrives as full fields (Forest Green, Crest Yellow, Mandarin Orange) on a cream ground, and structure comes from 2 px ink rules, ruled spec rows, square corners and one grotesque used at two widths. It rejects the dark neon gaming dashboard and the grid of identical rounded translucent cards.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered plates: an object's catalogue number follows it across every screen
Flat colour fields, 2 px ink rules, square corners
One grotesque, two voices: normal width to read, condensed heavy for numerals and titles
Live data in ruled tables and axis-labelled charts, never metric tiles or sparklines
Safe by construction: every destructive action shows what it will do first, and the engine decides

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Mandarin is a fill or a rule carrying ink, never text. Crest is for forest and ink grounds, never for text on cream.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: One Mandarin button per screen; everything else is secondary, quiet, or danger for irreversible actions only.

rules.name: The Earned Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what deserves attention: a live value, a high usage, the current selection.

rules.name: The Numerals Identify Rule
rules.body: Large numerals are catalogue numbers of objects, never section, step or page numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Aligned figures use tabular numbers; live ones roll like a counter instead of jumping.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere. To stand out, take a heavier colour field or a rule.

dos: Do use Mandarin only as a fill or rule carrying ink text, for the one primary action, live values, high usage and the current selection.
Do keep every border 2 px solid ink and every radius 2 px or less.
Do give each object its fixed catalogue number and reuse it on every screen.
Do state what an action will do, in plain French, before it does it, and show the way back or say there is none.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: travel becomes a short fade.
donts: Don't use Crest Yellow as text or a thin line on cream (1.08:1).
Don't add shadows, blurs, glass, tinted gradients or glow.
Don't use hero-metric tiles, sparklines as content, or a grid of identical rounded cards.
Don't let colour carry meaning alone: also write the state.
Don't make the web page the authority on what may be deleted or closed: the engine decides and re-checks.
